title: Cold-email IQ meme contrasts simple outreach vs infrastructure theater
summary: Cody Schneider's IQ-style thread argues effective cold email is a tight list, short problem-plus-offer copy, volume, and pipeline KPIs—not domain farms, spintax, and nine-step bump sequences.
question_it_answers: What cold-email setup does this meme treat as high-ROI versus midwit infrastructure theater?

claims.text: High-IQ cold email uses a precise list, short copy, one offer, volume, and meetings KPI.
claims.evidence: Precise list, short email, one specific offer, high volume, hygiene done once. Measure meetings held and pipeline, nothing above it.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Midwit panel lists mailbox farms, warmup, spintax, and nine-step bump sequences as failure mode.
claims.evidence: 40 domains, 120 mailboxes, a rotation schedule, and a spreadsheet tracking mailbox health
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents
